Metadata.title: High-Speed Rail Booking
Metadata.description: An unofficial course project recreating train search, booking, member, and test-payment flows for Taiwan high-speed rail travel.
Metadata.author: Fu Jen Catholic University Database System Course Project
Metadata.keywords: high-speed rail booking,Taiwan rail,train search,Next.js,Supabase,course project

tickets.limit: Up to {count} tickets can be booked per transaction.

captcha.label: Verification Code
captcha.help: Enter the six digits shown. The code expires in five minutes and can be used only once.
captcha.helpWithTime: Enter the six digits shown. The code refreshes automatically in {seconds} seconds.
captcha.refreshed: The verification code has been refreshed.
captcha.audioUnavailable: Audio playback is not supported by this browser.

errors.sameStation: Departure and destination stations must be different.
errors.dateOutOfRange: The date is outside the current 29-day booking window.
errors.returnBeforeDeparture: The return date cannot be before the departure date.
errors.ticketLimit: The ticket limit was exceeded. Select no more than {count} tickets.
errors.stationLoad: Stations could not be loaded from the database. Please refresh and try again.
errors.captchaLoad: The verification code could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.
errors.captchaInvalid: The verification code is incorrect, expired, or already used. Enter the new code.
errors.captchaExpired: The verification code was refreshed. Enter the new code and search again.
errors.searchFailed: Schedules and fares could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.

result.loaded: Schedule search complete: {outbound} outbound and {inbound} return services.
result.noResults: No service matches this date, time, or train number.
result.matchingSeats: Seats matching the cabin and preference: {count}
result.selectBoth: Select one outbound and one return service.
result.selectionReady: Your services are selected. Continue to passenger details and booking confirmation.

notices.title: Important Information
notices.bookingWindow: Tickets may be booked up to 29 days in advance and no later than one hour before departure.
notices.ticketLimit: Each transaction may include up to 10 tickets, or up to 5 tickets per leg for a round trip.
notices.payment: Complete payment within the stated time. Unpaid reservations will be cancelled automatically.

Checkout.title: Confirm booking
Checkout.subtitle: Review the services and passengers. Seats will be held for 10 minutes after confirmation.
Checkout.missingBody: Return to the home page, search again, and select a service.
Checkout.loginBody: Signing in ensures that only you can view or cancel this booking.
Checkout.name: Name
Checkout.passwordHelp: Use at least 8 characters with a letter and a number.
Checkout.emailConfirmation: Your account was created. Verify your email, then return here to sign in.
Checkout.authFailed: Unable to sign in. Check the email and password.
Checkout.passengersBody: Assign one passenger to every ticket. A passenger cannot be used twice.
Checkout.idNumberHelp: Only a masked document number is shown. Production deployments should encrypt or tokenize this value.
Checkout.studentNote: Student fares require a passenger whose student status was verified by the system.
Checkout.noEligiblePassenger: No saved passenger is eligible for this fare. Add a passenger or change the ticket type.
Checkout.passengerFailed: The passenger could not be saved. Check the details and try again.
Checkout.holdNotice: Seats are assigned only after confirmation. Complete payment within 10 minutes after booking.
Checkout.bookingFailed: The booking could not be created. Seats may no longer be available. Search again.
Checkout.profileRequired: Your member profile is not ready. Sign out and sign in again.
Checkout.paymentNotice: This step holds the seats but does not charge a payment method. Connect a payment provider to continue from here.

Member.title: Member center
Member.subtitle: Review booking status, payment deadlines, and issued tickets.
Member.loadError: Bookings are unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
Member.emptyBody: Bookings will appear here after you select a service and confirm your passengers.
Member.loginBody: Email confirmation is disabled for this course project, so new accounts sign in immediately.

BookingDetail.loadErrorBody: This booking does not exist or does not belong to the signed-in account.
BookingDetail.title: Booking details
BookingDetail.demoBody: Use only the test card details provided by the system. No bank is contacted and no real payment is made.
BookingDetail.demoTipBody: Hover over or select this tip to view the details. Never enter a real credit card.
BookingDetail.demoCardError: The test card details are incorrect. Use all details shown in the tip.
BookingDetail.paidBody: The booking is confirmed and demonstration tickets have been issued.
BookingDetail.expiredBody: The payment deadline passed and the seats were released. Search for another service.
BookingDetail.confirmCancelBody: Cancelling immediately releases the seats and cannot be undone.
BookingDetail.cancelledBody: The booking was cancelled and its seats were released.
BookingDetail.actionError: The action could not be completed. Refresh and try again.
